THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
151
STUDY 050
Studded Leather & Hooded Jacket
Rights check
Source: 24392.jpg
Edgy, dramatic, confident
WORKING NOTES
- The studded belt and gloves are the signature accents.
- Describe the lighting as 'soft street light' to avoid harsh
flash.
Try this: Specify soft street light instead of harsh flash.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
loose dark brown curls peeks out from a
deep gray acid-washed hood. She
wears a cropped zip hoodie over a black
leather corset, a studded wide belt, and
a black leather pleated mini skirt.
Studded fingerless gloves and a studded
black shoulder bag complete the look.
Her expression is serious, with a bold
red lip. A city street at night with soft
ambient light. Palette of charcoal, black,
and silver studs. Edgy and dramatic, in
the style of a night-out street-style photo.
